Two human fingers are visible at the top, gently holding or petting the hamsters. A colorful patterned fabric is visible in the upper left background, and parts of white ceramic bowls are in the foreground.

The ear of the left hamster is visible, appearing rounded and proportionally large relative to the head, matching the taxonomy description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both subjects display the typical 'potato' shape of hamsters: stocky, compact, and lacking a defined waist or neck, fitting the 'diminutive, rounded proportions' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dense short fur in golden, brown, black, or white coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur texture appears dense and short. The left hamster is golden/brown with white markings; the right is brownish-grey. This matches the allowed coloration variants.
